verdict.rationale: First-party docs say merchants can issue refunds directly in the PayPal business dashboard. They also document server-side refund endpoints in the Checkout integration and expose `create_refund`/`get_refund` API-backed tools, so refunds are covered on both surfaces. However, partial-amount refunds are never explicitly documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of partial vs. full refund amounts on the dashboard and API, detailed refund API reference, independent or hands-on corroboration.
